per_company.name: Elbit Systems
per_company.evidence_note: The exact issuer is Elbit Systems Ltd., an Israeli company formed in 1996 in the Elbit Ltd. corporate demerger. Primary issuer and SEC sources verify a broad modern capital-markets history: NIS 1.1 billion Series A notes in June 2010; an approximately NIS 831 million public Series A expansion and approximately NIS 94.7 million institutional placement in 2012; approximately NIS 665 million of treasury-share equity sold in April 2019; NIS 1.9 billion Series B, C and D notes in July 2021; approximately USD 314 million of Series A commercial paper in 2023; USD 110 million of Series B commercial paper in September 2024; and an approximately USD 588.8 million underwritten ordinary-share offering closed in May 2025.
per_company.hold_note: Amounts remain in original disclosed currencies. Note and commercial-paper amounts are principal/par value; equity offerings use gross proceeds. The 1996 demerger distributed an operating business rather than disclosing cash proceeds to the issuer and is not recorded as a financing round. Share-market holders, classified investors and commercial-paper purchasers were not individually identified; distributors, underwriters, rating agencies and trustees are not investors. Customer contracts, acquisition consideration, bank facility availability and subsidiary activity are excluded unless the exact issuer received financing. The 2023 commercial-paper amount is the issuer's year-end aggregate Series A issuance, not an additional USD 314 million on top of the September USD 300 million announcement.
